plan.goal: Generate 2 candidate ideas for the selected gap on high gradient noise in direct VLB optimization.

args.instruction: The gap: directly optimizing the variational lower bound (L_vlb) for diffusion models suffers from high gradient noise during training, which the authors of Improved DDPMs addressed with importance sampling to reduce variance. The user wants two candidate research ideas that push on this gap — improving the optimization of L_vlb itself (better variance reduction, lower-noise gradient estimators, adaptive schemes), not just re-deriving importance sampling. Work each idea out concretely: the mechanism, why it should reduce gradient noise, and what would need to be tested.

steps.why: The user asked for two new ideas for the selected gap; a single generation call with two distinct angles is the lightweight route.
